name: TOT Order Diagnostics Tool
version_name: 3.21.1 — Tax Rules tab on PRODUCTION (live keys only); optional "Remember on this computer" restored for live credentials.
description: Looks up an order from Shopify, BigCommerce, or WooCommerce and checks it for common tax and verification problems. Also includes tools for scanning tax data across all client stores, digging into one order's tax history, and checking on ID verification issues.
